visits.definition: Recorded visits to the online store.

completion_rate.definition: Recorded completed payments divided by recorded checkout attempts.

latency_ms.definition: Mean payment-service latency in the observed minute; null means missing.

stock_available_share.definition: Available share of the same fixed assortment.

collection_completeness.definition: Observed monitor of the share of transaction records captured.

intervals: Minutes from 09:00 with exclusive end; observations cover 0 through 119.
